sar.narrative: This Suspicious Activity Report documents an undocumented coordinated fraud pattern under internal case AC-HHF-013. The investigation involves customer C06115 and card C06115-K1, which is connected to 16 other cards including C00534-K2, C01357-K1, C01507-K1, C01594-K1, C01727-K2, C02167-K2, C03060-K1, C04146-K1, C04668-K1, C05610-K1, C06639-K1, C08384-K1, C10350-K1, C11617-K1, C11743-K2, and C11940-K1 through a shared recipient email domain. On 2017-01-05 at 16:51, online transaction 3660311 ($181.16) for product code C was conducted in billing region 203.0. On 2017-01-22 at 19:57, online transaction 3660312 ($140.59) for product code C was conducted in billing region 191.0. Both transactions paid recipient email domain sc.rr.com, forming a coordinated recipient-email mule ring across 17 total cards with no shared device profile. This activity is suspicious as product code C online transactions to this recipient domain deviate from the cardholder's baseline of 83 prior transactions with a median amount of $140.59 and maximum amount of $2,945.01. No prior suspicious activity report has been filed on this card, and OFAC screening of the customer and card identifiers against the SDN list returned no match. Case AC-HHF-013 was opened on 2017-01-26, monitoring of connected cards was initiated, and escalation to an analyst was executed, while a block of card C06115-K1 is recommended and awaits team-lead approval alongside the filing of this report for a total suspicious exposure of $321.75.
